title: STUFFED CHICKEN
instructions: --Put a pint of milk into a saucepan with a good handful of crumbs of bread and boil until very thick. Set away to cool. Add to this parsley, chopped green onion,  thyme,  salt,  pepper, piece of butter and the yolks of four eggs, and place in doby of chicken, sewing up the opening. Roast the chicken between rashers of bacon.
